verdict.rationale: Lago documents a purpose-built 'Dunning Agent' that autonomously reads a customer's payment history, invoices, and disputes, then acts (chasing overdue invoices) before escalating exceptions to a human, plus a broader Agent SDK/AI agent for billing operations described in plain language. This is concrete evidence of background autonomous automation, but it's scoped narrowly to billing/collections tasks rather than general-purpose automation, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of it running unattended in production. Missing for 10: broader automation scope beyond dunning/collections, independent verification of autonomous background operation.
